reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Whole workpieces retain both screw locations and every reuse cycle; prior torque allowed only after completed same-hole operation. Strong adverse evidence: 27/2500 assigned operations lack the 700–1300 degree target window. Prediction includes the first sampled crossing 250 degrees and overshoot; this must not become arbitrary future access.

mechanism.rationale: Torque history is consistent with retained thread engagement; geometry, wear, friction and station effects remain confounded.

novelty.rationale: History compression is an operational approximation; no universal wear law or new constitutive mechanism is established. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Whole workpieces retain both screw locations and every reuse cycle; prior torque allowed only after completed same-hole operation.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.
